title: Floater Off One Foot
description: Players practise the floating one-foot finish used to shoot over a taller defender without fully attacking the rim for a contested layup.

content.objective: Release a soft floater early, before reaching the rim, to finish over a taller defender.
content.setup: Players attack from the elbow with a ball, driving toward the lane.
instructions: Drive two or three steps into the lane at a controlled pace.
Rise off one foot well before reaching the rim.
Release the ball high and soft with a lot of arc, aiming just over the front of the rim.
Land balanced and retreat to get back on defense.
coachingPoints: Release earlier than feels natural — that's what beats the help defender.
Use a high, soft arc rather than a flat shot.
Keep the eyes on the target, not on an imaginary shot-blocker.
commonMistakes: Driving all the way to the rim instead of releasing early.
Shooting flat instead of with a high arc.
Bringing the ball down low where it can be knocked away.
content.safety: Make sure the landing area is clear before driving at speed.
